title: Images Added where a Vehicle's Documents Have Been Checked Repeatedly
content:
The pattern of document checks standing on a Keyturn Vehicle Listing over the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date adds images to the figure the marketplace holds.

| Verified documents in the rolling twenty-four months | Any of them failed its check | Added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | at least 1 failed | 3 images |
| 2 or more | none failed | 1 image |
| any other case | — | 0 images |

As clauses: a vehicle carrying two or more verified documents in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date, at least one of which failed its check, adds 3 images; one carrying two or more verified documents in that window with none failing adds 1; and any other vehicle adds none on this ground.

*Where the count divides.* A vehicle with exactly 2 verified documents in the window is on one of the first two rows; one with a single verified document in the window falls to the last row, whether that check passed or failed. A vehicle with 7 verified documents in the window, one of them failed, is on the first row, which turns on at least one failure rather than on how many.
